text:
Anya: Quick plan for a micro PLG launch next week. Core asks: 2 launch posts, 1 short benchmark blurb for the blog, a 3-prompt onboarding email, and a simple inbound routing table. Keep it tight.
Mike: I'll draft email + two subject lines. Proposal: 200 credits, 72-hour expiry, day0 + day2 reminder. CTA variants: "Run 1 prompt" vs "Try 3 prompts".
Priya: Creative will do socials + hero. prefer a single stat callout and a dev-focused gif.
Zoe: Prompt ideas for day0 (copy-paste ready):
- "Generate unit tests for this function"
- "Summarize PR changes in 3 bullets"
- "Convert this sync snippet to async/await"
Anya: Good. Make sure the Playground link can pre-select the three prompts via param. e.g. https://play.redwood.ai/?preset=starter-3&utm_campaign=micro_launch
Olivia: I'll pull baseline numbers and suggest a conservative stat for the hero. Early estimate: baseline activation ~10% -> expected uplift 15-20% with prompts. I'll add CI and share sheet.
Mike: Routing rules (simple): if seeded_cohort=true AND tokens_7d > 8k => tag sales:hot; 1k-8k => growth:nudge; else auto-email drip. Implement with Segment track = "seed_credit.redeemed".
Priya: Social plan: technical post (gif + prompt), product post (short user vignette), webinar invite. schedule Fri, Sun, Mon.
Anya: Webinar: 25-min demo + 5-min Q&A. Include a live cost/latency comparison (64 vs 512 tokens). Zoe, can you prep a 2-slide bench?
Zoe: Yup, will do latency + cost numbers and one slide showing activation lift.
Mike: Email snippet:
````
Subject A: "200 credits to ship a feature"
Hi {{first_name}},
We seeded 200 credits so you can try Redwood. Try these prompts to see value fast:
- "Generate unit tests for this function"
- "Summarize PR changes in 3 bullets"
- "Convert this sync snippet to async/await"
CTA: "Run 1 prompt"
````
Anya: Keep messaging consistent: call out "same API across hosted/dedicated/private" and predictable latency.
Olivia: Sheet link incoming. I'll lock the stat by Wed EOD so creative can finalize hero.
MarketingBot: Webinar created Thu 11:00am — RSVP: https://cal.example/micro-launch (auto)
Anya: Small rollout: seed 300 accounts, monitor support load. Pause if >4 tickets/day per 100 accounts.
Priya: I'll post creative drafts to #design-review.
Mike: Tracking: add property seeded_cohort="micro_may_a" to user for cohort queries.
Anya: Thanks all — quick sync Tue 10 to finalize assets. End thread.
